title: Turning Torso
visualBrief: Complete nine-unit white twisting tower with punched windows, exposed glass triangular wing, separate steel spine, visible circular service crown and mapped southwest arrival.

nativeAxes.origin: Ground contact in exactQ206435 mapped frame

sourceFacts.facade: Curved aluminum panels with flat glass windows

appearance.identity: Nine white twisting units, recessed dark bands, glazed triangular wing and separate spiraling steel spine.
appearance.scope: Complete medium-fi Turning Torso tower retains nine five-floor twisted units, recessed interstitial bands, independent circular core,90degree sweep and separate spiraling external steel spine. Original62506-triangle master recipe is preserved unchanged and reproducible. Reviewed source corrects the two triangular-wing elevations to exposed dark curtain glazing, as seen in architect photos03/06/08, retaining punched windows within white aluminum on the broad elevations. Last-unit roof188m leaves the circular service crown visible to published190m; tiny tube tips are clipped to190m. Nine equal cycles and exact window counts remain original reconstruction rather than measured floor levels. Primary architect publishes190m,10.6m core inner diameter with2.5m base/.4m top wall, curved aluminum and flat glass; owner confirms nine units/five floors/54including intermediate levels and90degree twist. Mapped entrance gets reconstructed paired glazing, handles and short granite arrival path; no surveyed doorway hardware or threshold. Three canonical shared granite/concrete/painted-metal graphs; palette PBR glass; no copied or embedded photographs. Closeup retains fine facade joints, truss and floor struts; street drops tiny joints/frames and reduces tube facets; district merges broad window strips and retains major truss plus two pairs of floor struts per unit; skyline retains whole asymmetric twisted mass, nine bands, exposed glass wing, separate major spine/diagonals and core crown while omitting minor struts/windows. Separate Turning Torso Gallery parking parcel and its corridor, reflecting pool, surrounding canal, interior, temporary construction and exact panel curvature are outside this tower bundle; they are disclosed site context, not missing tower parts. Base and upper outlines follow unchanged map controls; upper overhang is intentional. Ground grade, night and physical-device timing/full-scene memory unmeasured.
